nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): adds two unsigned integers and asserts the result did not overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checks b <= a then subtracts, preventing underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplies and verifies a == 0 || c / a == b to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then performs integer division.
Owned() constructor: assigns the contract owner to the deploying msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) gating privileged functions.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): owner-only two-step ownership transfer, stores pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): the pending newOwner must call to finalize ownership; old owner is overwritten.
DarenHui() constructor: mints the entire supply to a fixed address and sets token metadata.
DarenHui.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus the balance held by address(0).
DarenHui.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns the raw balances mapping entry.
DarenHui.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to the recipient using SafeMath.
DarenHui.approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites the allowance from msg.sender to spender.
DarenHui.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances using SafeMath.
DarenHui.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns the nested allowed mapping value.
DarenHui.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls an arbitrary spender contract.
DarenHui fallback function (): payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting raw ETH.
DarenHui.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): owner-only rescue that calls an arbitrary token contract.
ERC20Interface.transfer(address to, uint tokens): interface declaration invoked on an arbitrary token address.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data): callback invoked on the caller-supplied spender.
Owned.owner: privileged address used by the onlyOwner modifier and read by transferAnyERC20Token.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner accepted via acceptOwnership.
DarenHui.symbol: public token ticker string set to DRH.
DarenHui.name: public token name string set to DarenHui.
DarenHui.decimals: public token precision, set to 18.
DarenHui._totalSupply: total minted token quantity stored as a plain uint.
DarenHui.balances: mapping(address => uint) of raw token balances.
DarenHui.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spend allowances.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller address used for balances, allowance ownership and access checks.
Arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd: raw uint addition performed before the overflow check.
Arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub: raw uint subtraction guarded only by an explicit require.
Arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul: raw uint multiplication with a post-hoc division check.
Arithmetic c = a / b in safeDiv: raw uint division guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state is written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-suppliable address.
